full_judgment: 2. The present respondent filed the Writ Partition No. 4176 of 2003 before the High Court Division challenging inclusion of holding No. 5/3, Pallabi Mirpur, Dhaka Under Mouza-Senpara parbatha, apartment to C.S. Khatian no. 419 converging 0.0825 acre (five katah) of land including a three storied building situated thereon belonging to the writ petitioners being enlisted in the 'ka' list of the abandoned property list in serial no. 14, published in the Bangladesh Gazette (Extra Ordinary) dated 23.09.1986 and the impugned judgment and order dated 31.03.2003 of the Court of Settlement, refusing to exclude the said property of the writ petitioners from the 'Ka' list of the abandoned building.
